responsibility: Lowers HIR type-related syntax into `rustc_middle::ty` representations by providing the shared `HirTyLowerer` machinery for types, lifetimes, consts, trait refs, and signatures; checking and matching generic arguments to parameters; translating bounds and where-predicates into internal predicates with implied and expanded obligations; forming trait-object types with object-safety, alias expansion, associated-type, `Self`, and lifetime validation; enforcing CMSE ABI constraints on function items and function-pointer types; emitting bare-trait-object lints; and supplying the targeted diagnostics and suggestions used when generic arguments, `Fn`-trait syntax, associated items, or other type-lowering constructs are malformed.
